title: MONTH_24 — Physical Activity (accelerometer)
description: Accelerometer file dates, wear time and derived activity measures from the 24-month contact.
$comment: The dictionary gives no unit column and no ranges for these items (units appear inside some descriptions, e.g. 'minutes/day'); none are asserted and measured values are typed number (D078). The row 'enmo_0plus - enmo_4000plus', which the source says provides 60 variables, is not in this category until the data provider lists the column names (D013).

firstFileDate.title: First timestamp of hdf5 file, date
firstFileDate.$comment: Source description says 'date' but states no format; typed as text, no pattern (D022, D078).

lastFileDate.title: Last timestamp of hdf5 file, date
lastFileDate.$comment: Source description says 'date' but states no format; typed as text, no pattern (D022, D078).

Pwear.title: Wear time. (The Pwear variable has been set to 1 during the night (midnight-6am), to “impute” sleep when the monitor was flagged as non-worn during those times.)

Pwear_morning.title: Number of valid hrs during free-living; between 00.01 and 06.00

Pwear_noon.title: Number of valid hrs during free-living; between 06:01 and 12:00

Pwear_afternoon.title: Number of valid hrs during free-living; between 12:01 and 18:00

Pwear_night.title: Number of valid hrs during free-living; between 18:01 and 24:00

Pwear_wkday.title: Number of valid hrs during free-living; weekday

Pwear_wkend.title: Number of valid hrs during free-living; weekend day

include.title: 1=Pwear>=48 & all Pwear_quads>=9. 2=Pwear>=48 & 3 Pwear_quads>=9
include.$comment: The codes are written inside the source description ('1=Pwear>=48 & all Pwear_quads>=9. 2=Pwear>=48 & 3 Pwear_quads>=9'); the dictionary lists no other value (D078).

imputed.title: 1=Data imputed if not worn (proportional to Pwear)

oneOf.title: Data imputed if not worn (proportional to Pwear)

imputed.$comment: The only value the source states is 1 (written inside the description); it states nothing for data that were not imputed, so none is asserted (D078).
